name: Fuse-switch
summary: A fuse-switch uses a fuse-link or fuse carrier as part of its moving switching contact system.
description: A fuse-switch uses a fuse-link or fuse carrier as part of its moving switching contact system. The equipment designation must identify the actual assembly rather than treating every fused switch as mechanically identical.
readingNotes: Read the manufacturer's construction and operating instructions to establish the switching mechanism.
